purpose: Actual model comparison, not a threshold-only recall claim
features: unchanged twelve-feature allowlist; no oracle/generator-risk feature additions

development.selection_primary: highest mean selection average precision across three seeds, deterministic candidate ID tie break
development.selection_secondary: recall among top 2 percent of selection scores; descriptive, not an additional selection optimization

reserved_final_evaluation.generation_rule: generate only after candidate, source hashes and frozen plan are written
reserved_final_evaluation.secondary: paired fraud recall at fixed 2 percent batch review budget; exactly 3000 alerts for both models
reserved_final_evaluation.intervals: 500 paired ordinary row bootstrap replicates, percentile 95 percent intervals; ranking and top-k recomputed within each replicate
reserved_final_evaluation.promotion_gate: positive lower 95 percent AP-difference bound AND no lower point-estimate recall at primary review budget; report secondary interval separately
reserved_final_evaluation.failure_rule: If gate fails, do not claim independently validated model improvement or tune against this test. Report the result and retain incumbent.

limits: Same known stationary synthetic mechanism, independent random draw; not real payments or future-time validation
Budget ranking uses no labels; count and budget fixed before final scores are seen
At a fixed alert count precision and recall share the same true-positive numerator
Bootstrap conditions on fitted models and does not capture training-seed uncertainty; three development seeds are limited
No claimed business savings, fairness validation, security certification or production inference service
